About Tokenade

Tokenade makes AI agents affordable by automatically cutting the tokens your agents consume — without changing how you work.

Who we are

Tokenade is built by Paul Irolla, an independent developer who got tired of watching AI agent bills spiral month after month. The mission is simple: make the productivity gains of AI coding accessible to every developer, not just those with a generous expense account.

Paul Irolla

Founder · AI & developer tools

See the full profile

Why we built it

Modern AI agents — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf — are powerful, but they are voracious token consumers. Every file read, every tool call, every context window refill adds up. A productive day of AI-assisted coding can quietly burn through tens of millions of tokens.

We built Tokenade to make token reduction automatic and measurable. Instead of manually pruning context or guessing which calls are expensive, Tokenade intercepts the flow — output filtering strips noise before it reaches the model, repeated reads are deduplicated, semantic code search and file skeletons (signatures only) spare your agent whole-file reads, and MCP output is compacted too, with dedicated handling for GitHub, Playwright, Postgres and other popular servers. `tokenade dashboard` opens a local report in your browser showing exactly how much you saved and what it cost before.

What makes Tokenade different

  • 1

    Works with every major AI agent — Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot, Windsurf — through each agent's own hooks or plugins, all set up by a single install command — zero per-agent configuration.

  • 2

    Runs locally: compaction happens on your own machine, so your codebase, prompts and file paths are never uploaded — and the code is open for you to audit.

  • 3

    Free and open source (MIT/Apache-2.0) — unlimited use, contributions welcome on GitHub.
